_comment: Candidate production hosts probed by the production-verify workflow FROM A GITHUB RUNNER (outside any sandbox). A candidate that answers /api/ready with 200 is handed to the production E2E job. The e2b entry is the AKBARAL! production runtime served on the workspace host; its hostname changes when the workspace is recreated, so update it there. Permanent hosting (owner action) is what makes a stable entry supersede it.
